source_text: Colligebant mane mane. Qui tarde venit nihil invenit. Sol iustitiae oritur; pigritia sterilis manet.
pass_a_gloss: They-were-gathering morning morning. Who late comes nothing finds. Sun of-justice rises; laziness barren remains.
pass_b_english: They gathered [[morning by morning >> Bible:Exodus 16:21]]. Latecomers find nothing. The [[sun of righteousness >> Bible:Malachi 4:2]] rises; laziness stays barren.
